title: Safety Violations Were Flagged Six Months Before Fatal Ammonia Leak At Tiruvallur Seafood Factory; No Action Taken
summary: The Directorate of Industrial Safety and Health (DISH) had reportedly identified multiple safety violations at St Peter & Paul Sea Foods Exports in Tiruvallur district nearly six months before the fatal ammonia leak that has so far claimed nine lives, raising questions over regulatory oversight and industrial safety enforcement, as reported in DT Next.
